title: Belrose Circle Membership Programme Schedule of Admission Conditions, Fees and Administration
content:
# Belrose Circle Membership Programme — Schedule of Admission Conditions, Fees and Administration by Tier

A customer holds a tier of the Belrose Circle Membership Programme only from the smallest age in whole years the tier sets, holds no more memberships of the tier than it allows, pays the fee the tier carries to join it and the fee it carries each membership year to hold it, is sent a points statement at the frequency the tier sets, and, where the membership is suspended, has it reviewed within the calendar days the tier sets. The figures by tier are as follows; fees are in USD.

## Schedule

| Tier | Minimum age (whole years) | Memberships of this tier per customer | Enrolment fee | Annual fee | Points statement | Suspension review (calendar days) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Belrose Circle Member | 18 | 1 | USD 0.00 | USD 0.00 | annual | 30 |
| Belrose Circle Silver | 18 | 1 | USD 0.00 | USD 0.00 | quarterly | 30 |
| Belrose Circle Gold | 18 | 1 | USD 0.00 | USD 0.00 | quarterly | 30 |
| Belrose Circle Platinum | 18 | 1 | USD 0.00 | USD 0.00 | monthly | 21 |
| Belrose Circle Black | 21 | 1 | USD 0.00 | USD 0.00 | monthly | 14 |
| Belrose Circle Founders' Club | 21 | 1 | USD 2500.00 | USD 1500.00 | monthly | 7 |

## Conditions

1. **Age.** A customer holds Belrose Circle Member, Belrose Circle Silver, Belrose Circle Gold or Belrose Circle Platinum only from the age of 18 whole years, and Belrose Circle Black or the Belrose Circle Founders' Club only from the age of 21 whole years. The age of 18 or 21 is the entry age of the tier as well as the smallest age at which it is held.
2. **Invitation.** The Belrose Circle Founders' Club is entered by invitation only, and its annual fee is payable as a condition of entry. No other tier requires an invitation.
3. **Fees.** No enrolment fee and no annual fee is charged at Belrose Circle Member, Belrose Circle Silver, Belrose Circle Gold, Belrose Circle Platinum or Belrose Circle Black. The Belrose Circle Founders' Club carries an enrolment fee of USD 2500.00 and an annual fee of USD 1500.00.
4. **Memberships per customer.** At every tier one customer holds at most 1 membership of that tier.
5. **Statements.** A Belrose Circle Member receives a points statement annually; Belrose Circle Silver and Belrose Circle Gold members quarterly; Belrose Circle Platinum, Belrose Circle Black and Belrose Circle Founders' Club members monthly.
6. **Suspension review.** A suspended membership is reviewed within 30 calendar days at Belrose Circle Member, Belrose Circle Silver and Belrose Circle Gold, within 21 calendar days at Belrose Circle Platinum, within 14 calendar days at Belrose Circle Black and within 7 calendar days at the Belrose Circle Founders' Club.

## Worked readings (hypothetical)

- A customer aged 20 whole years may hold any of Belrose Circle Member, Belrose Circle Silver, Belrose Circle Gold or Belrose Circle Platinum, and may not hold Belrose Circle Black or the Belrose Circle Founders' Club until the age of 21 whole years. A customer aged 21 whole years satisfies the age condition of every tier.
- A customer aged 17 whole years satisfies the age condition of no tier of the Belrose Circle Membership Programme.
- A member joining the Belrose Circle Founders' Club is charged USD 2500.00 to join and USD 1500.00 for each membership year they hold the tier; a member at any other tier is charged nothing on either count.
